For Petitioner : Mr.T.V.G. Kartheeban  For Respondent : Mr.K.M.D.Muhilan  Additional Public Prosecutor  ORDER
When the matter was taken up for hearing today, the learned counsel for the petitioner sought permission of this Court to withdraw this petition.
However, he submitted that the presence of the petitioner before the trial Court may be dispensed with.
2. In view of the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
Consequently, the connected Miscellaneous Petition in Crl.M.P.No.23127 of 2025 is closed.
